title: Voice Design in ElevenLabs: Create a New AI Voice from a Text Prompt
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: Voice Design in ElevenLabs: Create a New AI Voice from a Text Prompt.

Voice Design creates a new voice from a text prompt and gives you three options to choose from. This episode covers when to use it, the four steps, what it costs, the recommended prompt format with an example from the docs, the words that shape age, timbre, pacing and audio quality, common pitfalls, preview text, loudness and guidance scale, and Voice Remixing.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
